name: Quảng Ngãi

queries.query: Quang Ngai Vietnam official cadastral parcel map GIS land registry public viewer
queries.result: Search identified the official Quảng Ngãi provincial land-information portal and the official Quảng Ngãi city urban-planning GIS viewer. The viewer advertises parcel lookup by map sheet and parcel number, but no anonymous parcel feature response or public API was verified.

queries.query: Quảng Ngãi bản đồ địa chính tra cứu thửa đất hệ thống thông tin đất đai quy hoạch GIS
queries.result: Official Vietnamese-language results identify provincial land-information material, the city planning GIS, and current cadastral measurement/database work. The public viewer host was not reachable for route/configuration inspection, so no safe anonymous ID-plus-geometry response was obtained.

registryBasis: Official provincial and city sources evidence local land-information, cadastral-map/database, and planning-GIS custody in Quảng Ngãi. This establishes local registry/cadastral custody and an advertised public planning viewer, not an open parcel geometry API.

officialSources.observation: Official provincial land-information page with land-price, land-use-planning and land-regulation sections; local land access/procedure custodian evidence, but no parcel feature endpoint in the page content.

Official Quảng Ngãi city urban-planning and technical-infrastructure GIS portal; advertises parcel-plan lookup by map-sheet and parcel number and map-based information access. The host was not reachable from this request environment.

Official provincial report describes cadastral surveying, cadastral-map preparation, land-registration records and land-database construction; it is institutional/progress evidence, not a downloadable public parcel layer.

Public app listing describes the Quảng Ngãi planning application and parcel-plan lookup by coordinates or map-sheet/parcel number; listing is supporting discovery evidence and does not expose a safe public feature service.

notes: Exact WUP point preserved in latitude/longitude order. No exact-point hit/miss test was used. No parcel geometry or native parcel identity was retained. Packet completion is not source integration/admission; serial reviewer qualification remains required.
